display_information.name: Conduit
display_information.description: Publishes what a Slack channel says to a Conduit client.
display_information.long_description: Conduit is a Conduit surface for Slack. It reads the messages of the channels it is in and publishes them, in plain JSON, to a Conduit near end, which seals them and sends them on to a Conduit client. The app never sees a key of its own.

slash_commands.description: Publish what this channel says to a Conduit client.
